No figure for senior (6–10 y) or lead embedded/automotive engineers from a usable source: the only senior bands seen (₹22–45 LPA 'senior', DIYguru) come from a training-provider page and were EXCLUDED; Jooble's 'Autosar engineer' ₹10.7–13.8 L is a machine aggregate and was EXCLUDED; Glassdoor India results were individual self-reports (Cyient, TI) and were not recorded. Indian salaries are normally quoted as annual CTC (incl. employer PF, variable pay) — AmbitionBox does not separate base from variable in what was seen. All figures are search-snippet only: WebFetch failed with DNS errors (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) for every host tried (ambitionbox.com, glassdoor.co.in, payscale.com, stats.gov.cn, wikipedia.org, shigoto.mhlw.go.jp), so no page was read directly.
